name: quotefly
description: QuoteFly backend-first API platform for contractor quote automation

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n API,WEB,DB "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run prisma:studio"
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test tests/unit/ai-data-governance.test.ts tests/unit/data-governance-catalog.test.ts tests/unit/brand-logo.test.ts tests/unit/onboarding-branding-preservation.test.ts tests/unit/quote-brand-asset.test.ts tests/unit/quote-pdf.renderer.test.ts web/scripts/quote-draft-storage.test.ts web/scripts/quote-form-validation.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run lint:web && npm run prisma:validate && npm run test:security && npm run test:unit && npm run eval:ai && npm run audit:all
scripts.verify:ci: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run lint:web && npm run prisma:validate && npm run test:security && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run eval:ai && npm run audit:all
scripts.verify:launch: npm run verify:ci && npm run test:e2e
